review_method: Independent original map pixels, complete source and baseline-rendered ring plots, independently registered outlines, wider context, imprint and credits. All 76 ordered positions across three single-ring Polygons were compared with freshly reopened complete source geometry, decoded geometry and exact original inventory/core/detail joins. The original primary viewport, projected coordinate system and full-precision GPTS/LPTS controls were reopened. A full six-parameter affine retains both cross terms and explicitly applies original MediaBox/CropBox offsets. All 76 positions were independently registered; six original detail/context pixel arrays and two credit/imprint arrays match fresh PDF renders. Maximum control residual is below 0.001 PDF point, measuring affine consistency rather than shoreline accuracy. First pixel observations preceded source-research comparison. A preliminary Ball water/land misreading was corrected against original pale-cyan fill and white-land pixels before final conclusions. All three source-scope reviews are complete: two supported generalized identities and one hold. The production decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.
